metric_scope: Repeated means and sample standard deviations; real and simulated seconds kept separate
limitations: CPU/RSS are process measurements; per-operation process CPU includes overlapping work and is not summed as independent task consumption.
Configured CPU/memory budgets are admission accounting; no OS CPU affinity or physical isolation was applied.
P99 uses 24 successful workflow samples per case; repeated percentile means are not pooled percentiles.
Fixed policy execution order and background host activity remain possible timing influences; conclusions are descriptive.
Recovery uses one controlled before-forward call exception; it does not establish host/network outage reliability.
Simulation uses measured operation medians and explicit seeded perturbations; it does not run B1.
